summary: Stanly County fire tower on Nelson Mountain near Albemarle; standing in 1967, gone by 2009 with old leg supports left; the site is private.

facts.status_note: Gone by 2009, when only the old leg supports remained (NGS 2009 recovery note)

access.note: A 2014 recovery note says the station and its reference marks are on private property and permission for access was not granted

events.note: Survey recovery found the fire tower standing
Survey recovery found the lookout gone, with its old leg supports still on the site; the removal date is not recorded

notes_for_editor: Only one primary source (the NGS datasheet for station FA2122, named LONG, set 1948) describes the tower. The datasheet calls it a fire tower and a lookout tower. No build date, height, design or staffing appears in any source I could reach; two web searches and the cached NC lists found none, so those are left out of the story. The 1948 description gives a height of light above the station mark (30 m) that I did not use, because it is not clearly the tower's height. The 1967 and 1974 notes say microwave tower, the 1972 note says relay tower; the sources do not say whether they are the same structure. The 1974 note's fence around 'tower' is not clearly the lookout, so it is not used as proof the lookout stood in 1974. Status changed from unknown to gone (2009 note). Access is private per a 2014 geocaching group note; a human should check before anyone visits. Brief said status unknown and access unknown.
